ACTIVE.reason: The top rung of the genesis ladder. validate_transition guards it hardest of all - two reviewers plus a kernel-computed eval-window superiority proof - and no production path arrives to be judged. C4-d wired the chain as far as SHADOW (shadow_eval_bridge.py:308); EVAL_WINDOW and ACTIVE are the remainder of that arc. Kept, not deleted: the 2026-09-14 post-chain plan (row 11, measured promotion after ARIA-HIGH-125 and ARIA-HIGH-122) and program plan rev2 K-11 (genesis_superiority and agent_eval real mode in ARIA's own authoring loop) schedule the writer, and the kernel freeze admits it only after the chain closes. Expires with ORPHAN-HIGH-837 on the rev3.1 Faz 1 target: by then the rung has a writer or the program deletes it with what only it reads.

EVAL_WINDOW.reason: The rung between SHADOW and ACTIVE, and the reason ACTIVE is unreachable: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS admits ACTIVE only from EVAL_WINDOW, so an unproduced EVAL_WINDOW makes the ACTIVE gate unreachable regardless of how good its proof requirements are. Listed separately so wiring the window does not leave the promotion silently unwired. Same schedule and the same decision day as ACTIVE (ORPHAN-HIGH-837).
